label: Kick / influx
engineering_rationale: An influx is a pore-pressure-versus-mud-density problem. Formation match and TVD locate the pressure window, and the mud programme is judged as strongly as the rock because the balance that failed is a mud-weight decision. Surface distance is judged only equal to event history: connectivity matters, but a recorded kick next door is the stronger predictor than mere adjacency.
references: Saaty, T.L. (1980). The Analytic Hierarchy Process. McGraw-Hill, New York.
